origin.description: Style a string with a foreground and an optional background.

arguments.name: as
arguments.text: A style function, a name in styles(), or a value make_style() accepts.

arguments.name: bg
arguments.text: A background style function, or a value passed to make_style(..., bg = TRUE).

origin.details: NULL means no change. A name in styles() uses that style. Anything else is given to make_style. The background is applied first, then the foreground.

translation.description: Style a string with a foreground and an optional background.

arguments.name: string
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

arguments.name: as_
arguments.text: R's argument as. A style, a name, or a make_style() specification. The second positional argument is the same thing.

arguments.name: bg
arguments.text: Background style. A specification is passed to make_style with bg=True.

translation.details: as is a Python keyword, so the parameter is as_. style(text, "bold") still matches the R call. A missing side is left unchanged.
